name: app-shell
title: Collapsible app shell
description: Collapsible sidebar primitives (240px/64px rail, collapsed tooltips, hover flyout menus, persisted collapse state via an external store) plus a minimal nav-array-driven AppShell skeleton.
postInstall: Run `npx shadcn add popover tooltip` (required ui primitives), fill NAV_ITEMS in src/components/app-shell/app-shell.tsx with your own navigation, and render <AppShell> from your authenticated layout. If you build your own shell from sidebar-chrome.tsx primitives instead of using <AppShell>, wrap it in a TooltipProvider (exported by the shadcn tooltip primitive). Rename DEFAULT_SIDEBAR_COLLAPSED_STORAGE_KEY in sidebar-chrome.tsx if you want a project-specific localStorage namespace.
